title: ShareMember
description: share.member@1: a member with their Network identity fields. username, display_name and avatar_url are null when Network does not know the subject (or reports it banned or deleted).

key_fingerprint.description: The member's current key fingerprint from Network's key directory (locker.public-keys@1), shown to the owner of a people-locked item; null when the person has no locker key (or Network did not answer).

fingerprint_changed.description: Owner-only, for a people-locked item: true when the member's current key is not the one their key_slot was made for, so the sheet warns and re-wraps.
